description_en: Call CreateSnapshot to create a snapshot for a database file system
description_zh: 调用CreateSnapshot给一个数据库文件系统创建快照
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs create-snapshot --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --fs-id d-bp131n0q38u3a4zi00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSnapshot

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the DBFS instance resides. You can call DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database file system
parameters.name: fs_id

parameters.help_en:
The display name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

To prevent name conflicts with automatic snapshots, the name cannot start with \`auto\` or \`dbfs-auto\`
parameters.help_zh:
快照的显示名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。

为防止和自动快照的名称冲突，不能以auto开头和dbfs-auto开头
parameters.name: snapshot_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the snapshot. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh:
快照的描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。

默认值：空
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of the snapshot, in days. The snapshot is automatically released after the retention period expires. Valid values: 1 to 65536.

Default value: empty. This indicates that the snapshot is not automatically released
parameters.help_zh:
设置快照的保留时间，单位为天。保留时间到期后快照会被自动释放，取值范围：1~65536

默认值：空，表示快照不会被自动释放
parameters.name: retention_days

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique token on the client. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html)
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见如何保证幂等性 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html)
parameters.name: client_token
